description: Acceptance 0014: a refused accept (409 CapacityExceeded) falls back to the next bid; concurrent rentals never overcommit a bidder.

actions.label: Run 0014
actions.description: Three rentals on three one-VM bidders: refusals, the fallback, all Held, all released.

actions.label: Run 0014 concurrent

actions.label: Run 0014 exhausted
